# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen (Volume 1); around nineteen by Volume 3  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c6 P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive; married to Mr. Inglis  <sub>[v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pale Sands / Brierley  <sub>[v1 c6 P0](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0000), [v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher in Stonebridge  <sub>[v3 c26 P20](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0020)</sub>
- **Titles:** Flora Odette  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>; Miss Odette Pullen  <sub>[v2 c6 P33](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0033)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette has lovely skin, curly brown hair, and styles her hair very fashionably. She is sensible, unremarkable, and somewhat plump, with a round face.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c6 P35](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0035), [v2 c6 P53](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0053), [v2 c23 P20](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0020)_

## Personality

Odette is practical, sensible, and unadorned, lacking the vivid imagination of her friend Nell Harcourt. She is straightforward, dutiful, and occasionally prone to emotional crying despite her sensible nature. While she lacks ambitious artistic or romantic ideals, she takes pride in her domestic skills and approach to life.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c21 P13](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0013), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c24 P1](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0001), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021)_

## Goals

- Achieve financial independence and security through teaching or marriage  <sub>[v2 c30 P21](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0021), [v3 c39 P21](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0021)</sub>

## History

Flora Odette Tranter (later Pullen) assisted her mother at Pale Sands Cove in taking in adopted children from Nova Scotia orphanages. She studied for her Regent's Academy entrance exams alongside Sukey and others, eventually moving to Brierley and attending the local school. She formed a close friendship with Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, sharing in their childhood play and picnic adventures, though often providing a grounded, practical contrast to Nell's fantastical ideas. After graduating from Regent's, she became the schoolteacher at Stonebridge, earning a reputation for being strict yet dutiful. She participated actively in the Brierley Village Improvement Society, serving on various committees. Eventually, Odette gave up her teaching post to travel West, where she met and married Mr. Inglis, a wealthy mining man from Winnipeg. They later traveled to Europe on their honeymoon before settling into a grand mansion in Winnipeg.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c6 P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c6 P33](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0033), [v3 c26 P20](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0020), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P25](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0025)_

- Daughter of Mrs. Alexander Tranter (later referred to as Mrs. Gorham Pullen) and sibling to Gorham/Barney and Alice/Mattie  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v2 c6 P1](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0001)</sub>
- Attended Regent's Academy and prepared for her entrance exams alongside Nell and others  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c30 P20](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0020)</sub>
